## 蔚蓝 • 爱与奇迹的回响

### 第0~15章

- [序 · 终末始源](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E5%BA%8F-%E7%BB%88%E6%9C%AB%E5%A7%8B%E6%BA%90.md): 一切都在破灭，一切都在消逝，一切的美好都不复存.
- [第1章·基沃托斯](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC1%E7%AB%A0%E5%9F%BA%E6%B2%83%E6%89%98%E6%96%AF.md): 『……吾等所望，那七声的哀叹。』
- [第2章·谁？](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC2%E7%AB%A0%E8%B0%81.md): 而在当天早上。
- [第3章·兄弟也可以这么可爱吗](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC3%E7%AB%A0%E5%85%84%E5%BC%9F%E4%B9%9F%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E8%BF%99%E4%B9%88%E5%8F%AF%E7%88%B1%E5%90%97.md): 就在老师愣神时，芹香离开房间，去叫星野和穆宇去了。
- [第4章·柴关拉面](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC4%E7%AB%A0%E6%9F%B4%E5%85%B3%E6%8B%89%E9%9D%A2.md): 在阿拜多斯已经有几天了。
- [第5章·便利屋68](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC5%E7%AB%A0%E4%BE%BF%E5%88%A9%E5%B1%8B68.md): 晴朗的天空中没有一丝飘荡的云彩，巨大的光环仿佛永恒般悬挂于空中。
- [第6章·生理期……？](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC6%E7%AB%A0%E7%94%9F%E7%90%86%E6%9C%9F.md): 阿拜多斯春季的早上不是酷热，而是温和的。
- [第7章·什么！？](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC7%E7%AB%A0%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88.md): 早晨的光穿过窗户，留下如同一片白纸般形状的晨光投影。
- [第8章·不愿的重逢](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC8%E7%AB%A0%E4%B8%8D%E6%84%BF%E7%9A%84%E9%87%8D%E9%80%A2.md): "噗哈哈，你这反应太好笑了～"
- [第9章·往昔不再](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC9%E7%AB%A0%E5%BE%80%E6%98%94%E4%B8%8D%E5%86%8D.md): "笙泽。"
- [第10章](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC10%E7%AB%A0.md): 又是阿拜多斯一个寻常的早上。
- [第11章](https://wenliu197.github.io/AzureNovel/%E8%94%9A%E8%93%9D-%E7%88%B1%E4%B8%8E%E5%A5%87%E8%BF%B9%E7%9A%84%E5%9B%9E%E5%93%8D/%E7%AC%AC015%E7%AB%A0/%E7%AC%AC11%E7%AB%A0.md): “这里就是黑市啊。”
